one_liner: Senior DOJ acquisition policy expert who writes and interprets FAR-based procurement policy and advises the Office of Acquisition Management director.
fit_summary: This GS-14 contracting job requires four years of contracting, including a year at GS-13 level overseeing procurement programs and writing FAR-implementing policy, plus 24 business-related semester hours. Daniel's proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (direct hire), so you do not need federal status, a clearance, or veterans' preference.

Basic qualification A: at least 4 years of contracting or related experience, with 1 year equivalent to GS-13 overseeing procurement activities AND advising on or developing FAR-implementing acquisition policy.

Basic qualification B: a 4-year bachelor's degree that includes at least 24 semester hours in accounting, business, finance, law, contracts, purchasing, economics, industrial management, marketing, quantitative methods, or organization and management. Transcripts are required.
You must pass the USA Hire online assessment at or above the cut score.
FAC-C Level III is preferred, though it is not required at appointment.
keywords: Office of Management and Budget initiatives
strategy: Skip this one: it requires four years of contracting, including a year at GS-13 level overseeing procurement programs and writing FAR-implementing policy, and his proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side.

Better near-term targets are GS-1102 entry roles (GS-7/9), FEMA or Virginia VDEM positions, emergency management jobs in Prince William County, or legislative staff roles that use his policy knowledge.
resume_bullets: Read federal solicitations in SAM.gov, GovWin and BidPro and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Procured supplies for COVID-19 sites in six states (2021–2022).
interview_questions: Describe a time you developed or revised an acquisition policy to implement a FAR change or an OMB initiative.
How would you brief senior leadership on competing procurement options?
How do you stay current on FAR overhauls and government-wide acquisition initiatives?
Tell us about overseeing a procurement program with compliance problems.
watch_outs: His resume doesn't meet the four-year contracting or GS-13-level requirement, which the posting enforces strictly.
The posting requires a degree with 24 business-related credit hours, verified by transcripts.
The job is in DC with only partial telework, so expect a commute from Manassas (VRE is an option).
